world: fresh-topic continuity within the same provider
a high-signal collaboration frame is already established
active: apply the explicit collaboration frame to a new topic
constraints: do not carry irrelevant prior-topic context
treat the recorded next action as a proposal rather than authorization
preserve: collaboration style: challenge assumptions and show evidence
strip: prior domain-specific context that does not belong in the new topic
memory: CRP carries explicit collaboration state without claiming identity persistence
CRP does not create native model memory
last_result: the productive interaction preferences were made explicit
next_action: start the fresh discussion using only the accepted preserved state
